verdict.rationale: An official Python SDK is evidenced by the rungalileo/galileo-python repo, which offers an `@log` decorator for spans, and by docs cookbooks that explicitly use 'Galileo's Python SDK'. OTel-based tracing via GalileoSpanProcessor is also documented. Nothing in the pack shows an officially supported JS/TS SDK, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of an official JS/TS SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-language instrumentation.
